## Resend Inbound Gateway
Verifies the Svix signature on Resend inbound-email webhooks and forwards valid events to the Helpdesk backend at /api/internal/resend-inbound.

Required n8n environment variables: RESEND_INBOUND_SECRET (Svix secret, whsec_...) and HELPDESK_BACKEND_URL (Render backend base URL).

Required credential: httpHeaderAuth named "DailyPlate Internal Token" with Name = X-Internal-Token and Value = INTERNAL_API_TOKEN (must match Render).
